name: Röttger et al. Rendering
definition: Uses a 3D texture map parameterized by front scalar value, back scalar value, and thickness to look up the volume rendering integral for an arbitrary transfer function, which may include isosurface effects.
summary: Röttger et al. Rendering accelerates volume rendering by replacing per-voxel integration with hardware-accelerated lookups from a pre-computed 3D texture parameterized by front and back scalar values and distance.
